import os import sqlite3 from datetime import datetime, timezone from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, render_template_string app = Flask(__name__) app.secret_key = os.environ.get("APP_SECRET", "dev-secret") DB_PATH = "db.sqlite3" # --- Database Initialization --- def init_db(): conn = get_db() try: conn.execute(""" CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS entries ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, last_modified_by TEXT NOT NULL, last_modified_at TEXT NOT NULL ) """) conn.execute(""" CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS edits ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, entry_id TEXT NOT NULL, contributor TEXT NOT NULL, summary TEXT, content TEXT NOT NULL, edited_at TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (entry_id) REFERENCES entries(id) ) """) conn.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_entries_last_modified ON entries(last_modified_at)") conn.commit() finally: conn.close() def get_db(): conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row return conn init_db() # --- HTML Templates --- ENTRY_LIST_HTML = """ Wiki Entries

Wiki Entries

    {% for entry in entries %}

  • {{ entry.title }}

    Last modified: {{ entry.last_modified_at }}

    • {% else %}
  • No entries found.
    • {% endfor %}
""" ENTRY_HTML = """ {{ entry.title }}
Last modified: {{ entry.last_modified_at }}
Last modified by: {{ entry.last_modified_by }}
{{ entry.content }}

View history

""" EDITS_HTML = """ Edit History for {{ entry.title }}

No edits found.

{{ edit.contributor }} on {{ edit.edited_at }} {% if edit.summary %} - {{ edit.summary }}{% endif %}
{{ edit.content }}
{% endfor %} """ # --- API Routes --- @app.route('/entries', methods=['GET']) def list_entries(): conn = get_db() try: rows = conn.execute("SELECT id, title, last_modified_by, last_modified_at FROM entries ORDER BY last_modified_at DESC").fetchall() finally: conn.close() entries = [dict(r) for r in rows] return render_template_string(ENTRY_LIST_HTML, entries=entries), 200 @app.route('/entries/', methods=['GET']) def get_entry(entry_id): conn = get_db() try: row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM entries WHERE id = ?", (entry_id,)).fetchone() finally: conn.close() if not row: return jsonify({"error": "Entry not found"}), 404 entry = dict(row) return render_template_string(ENTRY_HTML, entry=entry), 200 @app.route('/entries/', methods=['PUT']) def update_entry(entry_id): data = request.get_json(silent=True) if not data: return jsonify({"error": "Invalid request"}), 400 content = data.get("content") modified_by = data.get("modifiedBy") summary = data.get("summary") if not content or not modified_by: return jsonify({"error": "Missing required fields (content, modifiedBy)"}), 400 conn = get_db() try: # Check if entry exists existing = conn.execute("SELECT id FROM entries WHERE id = ?", (entry_id,)).fetchone() if not existing: return jsonify({"error": "Entry not found"}), 404 now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() # Update entry metadata and content conn.execute( "UPDATE entries SET content = ?, last_modified_by = ?, last_modified_at = ? WHERE id = ?", (content, modified_by, now, entry_id) ) # Record the edit in history conn.execute( "INSERT INTO edits (entry_id, contributor, summary, content, edited_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", (entry_id, modified_by, summary, content, now) ) conn.commit() finally: conn.close() return jsonify({ "id": entry_id, "title": existing[0] if existing else entry_id, # Simplified title handling, ideally stored "content": content, "lastModifiedBy": modified_by, "lastModifiedAt": now }), 200 @app.route('/entries//edits', methods=['GET']) def get_edits(entry_id): conn = get_db() try: # Check if entry exists entry = conn.execute("SELECT id FROM entries WHERE id = ?", (entry_id,)).fetchone() if not entry: return jsonify({"error": "Entry not found"}), 404 # Fetch edits history rows = conn.execute( "SELECT contributor, summary, content, edited_at FROM edits WHERE entry_id = ? ORDER BY edited_at DESC", (entry_id,) ).fetchall() finally: conn.close() edits = [dict(r) for r in rows] return render_template_string(EDITS_HTML, entry={"title": entry_id}, edits=edits), 200 @app.route('/entries', methods=['POST']) def create_entry(): data = request.get_json(silent=True) if not data: return jsonify({"error": "Invalid request"}), 400 title = data.get("title") content = data.get("content") created_by = data.get("createdBy") if not title or not content or not created_by: return jsonify({"error": "Missing required fields (title, content, createdBy)"}), 400 entry_id = str(uuid.uuid4()) if False else entry_id # Placeholder logic, need uuid # Actually need to import uuid entry_id = os.urandom(12).hex() # Simple unique ID generation now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() conn = get_db() try: conn.execute( "INSERT INTO entries (id, title, content, last_modified_by, last_modified_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", (entry_id, title, content, created_by, now) ) # Record initial creation as an edit conn.execute( "INSERT INTO edits (entry_id, contributor, summary, content, edited_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", (entry_id, created_by, "Created entry", content, now) ) conn.commit() finally: conn.close() return jsonify({ "id": entry_id, "title": title, "content": content, "lastModifiedBy": created_by, "lastModifiedAt": now }), 201
